records.text: Menachem Begin gifted Jerry Falwell Sr. a Learjet in 1979.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: in 1979, Jerry Falwell Sr. was gifted a Learjet from the founder of the Likud party, then prime minister of Israel, Menachem Begin.

verification.notes: Multiple independent historical accounts describe the Israeli government or Menachem Begin providing Jerry Falwell with a Learjet in 1979. The transfer is well documented in secondary histories, though a primary transfer record was not located.

verification.notes: Washington Post and Christianity Today reporting document Moon-affiliated financial support to Jerry Falwell Sr.’s Liberty University and Falwell’s subsequent participation in Moon-linked events.

appearances.snippet: He had a male mentor. ... Who bought him and everyone in his family, allegedly, brand new cars. ... And this daddy mentor of his is the one that pushed for Jerry Falwell Sr. to give Johnnie a position with Liberty University. ... That man's name is Ron Godwin, Johnnie's mentor.

verification.notes: This is an anonymous composite allegation about private financial support and internal personnel pressure. No attributable, independently checkable corroboration was located.
